Because the ocean stake is held until the jade settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the lagoon audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 46% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
